module: Tool library and shared state of all photo mode modules (ui_photomode_*). It contains the session state table S, the debug log, normalization functions (numbers, booleans, paths), protected (pcall) accesses to VariableRegistry, to the settings and to the "screenshot" capture API, as well as the computation of media action availability (upload, Steam, share URL opening).
notes: The log uses the tag "ui_pause_photomode" (leftover from an old name) and debug is enabled by default (isDebugEnabled = true).
S.routePayloadContractVersion = 8 and S.photomodeMetadataStateVersion = 2 (versions of the route payload and state metadata formats).

S notably contains: sessionActive, activeProfile ("pause" by default), photoModeOpen, the session restore states (camera, scene, effects, advanced render, node grabber), the saved bookmarks, pendingPreviewPlayback, pendingMotionCapture, captureInProgressFramesRemaining, exitConfirmationBypass, pendingExitNavigation, persistentSessionState and panelSurfaceMode ("hidden" by default).

Media actions: upload requires a screenshot.publish backend, onlineFeatures == "enable", OnlineServiceProvider.isWorking and a logged-in account; the Steam action requires the same conditions except the account; URL opening requires openWebBrowser. Possible reasons: backend_unavailable, online_features_disabled, online_service_unavailable, online_account_required, browser_unavailable.
The internal label table also contains shipping_build_required, but buildMediaActions never produces this reason.

S.desc: Mutable state table shared by all photo mode modules (active session, restore states, pending preview playback, etc.). The other modules read and write it directly via ui_photomode_shared.S.

isDebugEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the photo mode debug log is enabled.

setDebugEnabled.desc: Enables or disables photo mode debug and propagates the setting to the screenshot API (setDebugTracingEnabled) if available.

logDebug.desc: Writes an Info-level message prefixed with "[Photomode]" if debug is enabled.

stringifyDebugPayload.desc: Converts a payload to text for the log: empty string for nil, string unchanged, otherwise JSON (jsonEncode) or tostring on failure.

playPhotoCaptureSound.desc: Plays the photo capture sound (FMOD event "event:>UI>Main>Photo" on AudioGui).

clampNumber.desc: Converts to a number and clamps between minValue and maxValue; returns fallback if the value is not numeric.

fallback.desc: Value returned if the conversion fails (not clamped).

normalizeBoolean.desc: Converts a value to a boolean: boolean unchanged, number (~= 0), strings "true"/"1" and "false"/"0" (case-insensitive); otherwise fallback == true. nil gives fallback == true.

hasAnyDescribedField.desc: Indicates whether the state table contains at least one of the fields described by fieldDescriptors (key field.key non-nil).

state.desc: Table to test; a non-table gives false.

returns.desc: true if a field is present.

buildDescribedState.desc: Builds an output table from source by copying only the described, non-nil fields, applying field.normalize if present and renaming the key to field.outputKey if defined.

getCoreCameraFunction.desc: Returns the function core_camera[name] if it exists, otherwise nil.

name.desc: Name of the core_camera function (for example setPosRot, setFOV).

normalizePathForCompare.desc: Normalizes a path for comparison: backslashes converted to /, leading slashes and trailing spaces removed, converted to lowercase.

normalizePreviewNumberArray.desc: Checks that a table contains at least expectedLength convertible numbers and returns a copy of the first expectedLength; nil if one is missing.

expectedLength.desc: Number of expected elements (3 for a position, 4 for a quaternion).

readVariableRegistryValue.desc: Reads a VariableRegistry variable (protected by pcall). Returns nil if the registry is unavailable or on error.

writeVariableRegistryValue.desc: Writes a VariableRegistry variable (protected by pcall, error logged).

readSettingValue.desc: Reads a setting via settings.getValue (protected by pcall); nil if unavailable or on error.

writeSettingValue.desc: Writes a setting via settings.setValue (protected by pcall, error logged).

writeSettingsState.desc: Applies several settings at once via settings.setState (protected by pcall).

notifySettingsUi.desc: Asks the UI to refresh by calling settings.notifyUI (protected by pcall).

getScreenshotApi.desc: Loads the "screenshot" module with pcall(require) and returns it, or nil if unavailable.

buildMediaActions.desc: Computes the availability of photo mode media actions from the runtime context (shipping build, online features, online service, logged-in account, screenshot backends, browser).

returns.desc: {runtime={shippingBuild, uiDevMode, onlineFeaturesEnabled, onlineServiceWorking, onlineAccountLoggedIn}, capture={upload, steam}, preview={openShareUrl}}; each action is {visible, enabled, reason, reasonLabel}.
